validation.active_live_overlay: Observed on Built-in Retina Display (AppKit screen 1) during E051 native A0 combat; displayed the exact live game run ID and action flow

limitations: The native overlay requires macOS and PyObjC; the localhost browser monitor remains the cross-platform fallback.
Jev confidence and probabilities are model outputs, not calibrated win probabilities.
The overlay was observed during active native combat on the built-in display, but click-through over fullscreen combat was not independently exercised by a game input test.
decision: Keep PR open for user visual acceptance; no gameplay policy change or win-rate claim. Fullscreen click-through acceptance remains unverified.
